newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco sees full rate for smelter.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco sees full rate for smelter.

text.p: Comalco Ltd said on Friday that it expects its Bell Bay smelter in Tasmania to produce 119,000 tonnes of aluminium in 1996, rising to 137,000 tonnes in 1997.
The anticipated production runs follow resumption of the smelter to near-full operating capacity after being partially shut down since 1994.
Comalco reduced output at the smelter to an annual rate of 94,000 tonnes a year in 1994 due to difficult international economic conditions by closing one line of reduction cells.
Production in 1995 was 97,000 tonnes, the company said.

Comalco also said it expects to sign a new power contract with the Tasmania state government and the Hydroelectric Commission around the end of this year, which will provide the smelter with 256 megawatts of power through to 2014.
The next major project at the smelter will be to spend over A$40 million to improve the facility's environmental performance, Comalco said.
Comalco is 67 percent owned by RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd.
